correctness.rationale: For each order one through eight, inversion graphs of all n! permutations exhaust permutation graphs. Exact globally interned shared colour refinement (through 2n rounds, agreeing with n-round partitions) computes C2 equivalence; exact NetworkX isomorphism deduplicates representatives within each colour class. The full verified isomorphism totals are 1,2,4,11,33,142,776,5699 and C2 quotients 1,2,4,11,33,140,770,5654. At n=6 exactly two doubletons with 7 and 8 edges; at n=8 nontrivial multiplicities 38 of size two, 2 of size three, 1 of size four. All underlying finite certificates have been executed, with independent coded corroboration. No infinite conclusion follows.

value.rationale: Permutation graphs are a natural and extensively studied class with identified higher-dimensional Weisfeiler–Leman bounds, making the first failure of one-dimensional counting logic a structural invariant. The complete n=6 first layer has two distinct nonisomorphic equivalence pairs, while the n=8 quotient has 41 nontrivial classes including a quadrupleton. Exact multiplicity counts provide finite benchmarks for C2 expressive power beyond known raw graph counts. The bounded natural classes and sharp threshold carry self-contained value independent of all-size consequences.
